requirements.sourceQuote: A Bachelor's degree in physics or at least an equivalent degree from a university, a university of applied sciences, a cooperative university or a recognised foreign higher education institution in the field of physics or in a related or subject-specific course of study at the level of at least three years of study, evidenced either by:
an academic final examination with a Bachelor's degree with an overall grade of 2.4 or better, or
a Bachelor's thesis graded 2.0 or better, or
being in the top 20% of the applicant's year group, or, if no degree has yet been awarded,
previous study and examination achievements in the amount of at least 140 ECTS credits up to the time of submission of the application with an average grade of 2.7 or better, as well as
